targetText: The endeavor of women to earn their own living and to attain personal independence is, to some extent at least, regarded as a just one by bourgeois society.
summary: Tracking the rapid influx of women into capitalist factories, sweatshops, and industrial trades, Bebel shows how machinery allows capitalists to replace male workers with lower-paid women and children, subjecting working women to intense exploitation while laying the material basis for their collective organization.
